apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 197 recovers a provider-confirmed expired saved session by refreshing the account list and resuming a single current session for the same game. Temporary network failures remain retryable; ambiguous matches are not automatically claimed. Retains full-stream status-bar hiding, account discovery, video/HUD preferences, Metal 4, vibration, controller layouts and Sessions. 241 simulator tests passed, one hardware-only skip. Physical cross-device recovery pending. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
